answer: The garden index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the wharf queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 376 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the horizon. A farm of 137 pays that 87 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
